mapper.select: INSERT INTO novels (title, source_type, category_tags, char_count, form, chapter_count, author, platform, summary, run_id, story_settings, story_assets) VALUES (#{p.title}, #{p.sourceType}, #{p.categoryTags}::jsonb, #{p.charCount}, #{p.form}, #{p.chapterCount}, #{p.author}, #{p.platform}, #{p.summary}, #{p.runId}, #{p.storySettings}::jsonb, #{p.storyAssets}::jsonb) RETURNING id
